messages:
Nina: Coffee emergency: espresso machine doing a weird gurgle. Anyone brave enough to poke it? :scream:
Omar: I will fetch gloves. Will also bring backup instant coffee.
Bea: Instant is a portable hug. But also, filing a support ticket for the machine?
Theo: @CoffeeBot does your maintenance schedule cover dramatic gurgles?
CoffeeBot: Maintenance alert: Espresso pump check scheduled in 24h. For immediate help, try power cycle and check water reservoir.
Nina: Power-cycled. It now makes ghost sounds and an espresso that tastes like victory and slightly burnt toast.
Omar: That's the new 'charcoal roast' edition. Limited release.
Bea: Quick poll: best one-liner for the burnt-espresso experience. Winner gets first pour.
Theo: "When life gives you burnt espresso, add whipped cream and call it a latte"
Nina: "I like my coffee like my commits: bold and occasionally regrettable"
Omar: "This espresso has commitment issues"
Bea: :laughing: vote Bea's line with discreet wink.
CoffeeBot: Reaction tally: Theo 1, Nina 2, Omar 1, Bea 3. Winner: Bea. First pour reserved.
Nina: Also tiny PSA: kitchen towels are on the 2nd hook now. Please use them instead of paper towels.
Omar: Acknowledged. I will not be the villain who uses paper towels.
Theo: Will supervise first pour to ensure ceremonial dunking of biscotti is within policy.
Bea: I solemnly accept the pour and will protect mug honors.
CoffeeBot: Note: If machine fails completely, backup plan: coffee run to the shop on 5th. Volunteers?
Nina: Volunteer list: Omar (driver), Theo (navigator), Bea (snacks), Nina (moral support).
Omar: I'll grab oat milk and heroic pastries.
Theo: Moral support is my specialty.
Nina: Thanks team. Also: tiny one-liner competition continues daily at 10:03am. Bring energy, not grinders. :rocket:
